notes: All 25 candidates are stub pages under alumni.caltech.edu/in-memoriam (captured 2016): each is a death notice for one alumnus whose title gives the degree(s) and year(s) (PhD 1930-1998), with the rest of the page being navigation and membership boilerplate; about half link to an external obituary that is not in the saved text. None names a department, dissertation, adviser or first job, and none concerns an operations, management or industrial-engineering program (Caltech has no business school; the names that are recognisable are physical scientists and engineers). Classified not-a-list rather than single-record because the pages carry no field or placement evidence; if the integrator prefers to treat any page that states a degree year as single-record, all 25 could be relabelled mechanically. No institution corrections.
